name: Cratewright
tagline: Freight software for the people who pack every box by hand.
positioning: Cratewright helps small-batch makers route, crate, and track fragile goods — without duct-taping spreadsheets to a shipping label printer.

hero.h1: Every handmade order deserves a route that respects it.
hero.sub: Cratewright turns your ceramics, small-batch spirits, and made-to-order furniture into tracked, insured shipments — from the packing bench to the customer's doorstep.

features.title: Crate-aware rate shopping
features.description: Enter the fragile stuff once — dimensions, void fill, this-side-up rules — and compare live carrier rates that account for how you actually pack.

features.title: One manifest, every carrier
features.description: Print labels, packing slips, and customs docs from a single order. No more re-keying addresses between your Etsy tab and the postage screen.

features.title: Breakage-proof tracking
features.description: Automatic delivery updates and photo-confirmed handoffs, so you hear about a cracked vase from us before an angry customer.

features.title: Pickup routing for the bench
features.description: Batch your day's orders into a carrier pickup window that fits around glaze firings and market Saturdays, not the other way around.

testimonials.quote: I ship 40 stoneware sets a week from a converted garage. Cratewright cut my label-printing hour down to nine minutes and I haven't had a shattered plate claim since March.
testimonials.name: Marisol Trevino

testimonials.quote: We move small-batch bourbon across a dozen states, each with its own paperwork. Having the compliance docs auto-fill per shipment is the whole reason I switched.
testimonials.name: Grant Halloway

testimonials.quote: Made-to-order tables are heavy, awkward, and expensive to reship. The crate-aware rates alone paid for two seats in the first month.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For the solo maker who packs, labels, and ships it all themselves.
For growing studios with a shipping bench and a small crew.
For multi-location makers moving freight and pallets at scale.

homepage.footerBlurb: Cratewright is logistics software for people who still write 'fragile' by hand. Route it, crate it, track it — earnestly.
